name: CDP-Patches
notes: Offers sync and async input APIs bound to a browser or process id, for the active tab of a headful browser only. The Chromium bug behind the input leak is fixed upstream, which leaves Select elements as the remaining use; GNU GPL license.
summary: Python package that sends clicks, mouse moves, scrolling and typing to a headful Chrome window as OS-level input events, avoiding the input-domain leaks of CDP-dispatched events.
